mobbin:bd125cb4-4946-44ee-a252-1e51eddab.summary: From Square home the user opens 'Create item', picks a type, fills a dense point-of-sale (POS) form, saves, and lands on Item library with a short created message.
steal: An item-type chooser comes first so later fields match the kind of thing, which maps to Equipment vs Consumable vs Service (screen 2).
Internal name and customer-facing name sit on one form (screens 4–5).
Status, Categories, and Locations sit in a side menu beside the main form (screens 3–11).
A list status label with quantity (for example '20 available') plus a created message (screen 12).
avoid: Kitchen name, menus, sales channels, taxes, nutritional accordion, and dual retail or online prices are retail POS fields that fight a light sim-center catalog.
mobbin:bd125cb4-4946-44ee-a252-1e51eddab.fit: Inventory: example of what not to do for Essentials' light inventory. Replace with a short type, then name, unit, location, and photo create. Keep type-first and location side-menu ideas only.

mobbin:addf5027-28db-4b51-a6f7-24577166a.summary: From an empty Item library the user uploads a CSV, reviews an editable grid, chooses add-and-update vs overwrite, hits an all-failed error with a downloadable report, then sees 'Import Successful'.
steal: Before any items exist, dual path: Create an item, Import items, and Download template (screen 1).
An editable review grid before commit, with row delete (screens 5–6).
An explicit merge decision: 'Add and update existing' vs 'Delete and overwrite' (screen 7).
Failure pop-up: Require review vs Imported successfully counts, plus Download error report and Upload fixed errors (screen 9).
avoid: A blocking full-page import that warns 'don't leave this page' (screen 4) when a later step already allows closing and continuing elsewhere (screen 8).
mobbin:addf5027-28db-4b51-a6f7-24577166a.fit: Inventory: extends item first-time setup for centers migrating catalogs. Merge vs overwrite and the error-report loop help where failure cases are still undefined.

mobbin:981b5fb6-e739-4767-ac84-ddb20d085.summary: From Item library row actions the user opens 'Update low stock alert', sets amount and location, updates, and gets a short success message without leaving the list.
steps: Row menu Update low stock alert
steal: Low-stock settings are reachable from the list row more menu without opening full edit (screen 1).
Wording that names both places the alert appears: marked low stock in the library and a daily low stock alert email (screens 2–3).
Alert amount and Locations are set together (screen 3).
A stay-on-list success message after the threshold saves (screen 4).
mobbin:981b5fb6-e739-4767-ac84-ddb20d085.fit: Inventory: extends planned reorder and trend notifications: per-item threshold plus location plus digest email maps cleanly. Skip retail-only list extras.
